what: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
title: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
text: highdir R package provides unified, backend-agnostic API building figures either highcharter (interactive) ggplot2 (static). figure described hd_spec hd_opts object rendered either backend without changing calling code. package ships default use Helsedirektoratet colour palette, styling theme. Shiny GUI introduced make user friendly.

title: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
code: # Install from GitHub remotes::install_github("folkehelsestats/highdir") # Install from development version (dev branch) remotes::install_github("folkehelsestats/highdir@dev")

title: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
code: library(highdir)  df <- data.frame(   age  = rep(c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"), each = 2),   sex  = rep(c("Male", "Female"), 4),   pct  = c(42, 38, 55, 61, 48, 52, 60, 57),   n    = c(120, 115, 200, 210, 180, 175, 160, 155) )  # Describe the figure once spec <- hd_spec(df, x = "age", y = "pct", group = "sex", n = "n")  # How the figure should look like opts <- hd_opts(title = "Health survey",                 subtitle = "Source: Example data",                 caption  = "Tall om helse"                 ylim = c(0, 80))  hd_make(spec, "column", opts)                       # highcharter (default) hd_make(spec, "column", opts, backend = "ggplot2")  # static ggplot2 hd_make(spec, "line",   opts, smooth = TRUE)        # smooth spline hd_make(spec, "pie",    opts)                       # pie / donut  # Disable JavaScript (for static HTML export) hd_make(spec, "column", opts, use_js = FALSE)  # Save hd_save(hd_make(spec, "column"), "chart.html") hd_save(hd_make(spec, "column", backend = "ggplot2"), "chart.png")

title: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
code: # Set package-wide defaults for the session hd_set_theme(   hc_theme = "helsedirektoratet",   colors   = c("#025169", "#7C145C", "#C68803"),   font     = "Source Sans Pro" )  # All subsequent hd_make() calls use these settings automatically hd_make(spec, "column")

title: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
code: fig <- hd_make(spec, "column")  # Inline JS fig <- hd_add_js(fig, code = "console.log('chart loaded');")  # From a .js file fig <- hd_add_js(fig, file = "path/to/my-plugin.js")  # From a bundled plugin (inst/js/<name>.js) fig <- hd_add_js(fig, plugin = "my-plugin")

code: fig_spec(   data,   x,   y,   group = NULL,   n = NULL,   colour = NULL,   xlab = NULL,   ylab = NULL,   title = NULL,   subtitle = NULL,   caption = NULL,   ylim = NULL,   yint = 10,   flip = FALSE )

title: Create a Figure Specification — fig_spec
text: data data.frame (data.table) containing referenced columns. x Character. Column name x-axis variable. y Character. Column name y-axis variable (typically percentage count). group Character NULL. Column name used split data multiple series / groups. n Character NULL. Column name raw count variable shown highcharter tooltips alongside y value. Ignored ggplot2. colour Character NULL. Column name mapped colour aesthetic (ggplot2 ; highcharter uses group colouring). xlab Character NULL. X-axis label. Defaults x NULL. ylab Character NULL. Y-axis label. Defaults y NULL. title Character NULL. Chart title. subtitle Character NULL. Chart subtitle. Defaults "Kilde: Navn av kilder" highcharter engine NULL. caption Character NULL. Caption text shown chart (highcharter ). ylim Numeric vector length 2 NULL. Fixed y-axis limits, e.g. c(0, 100). NULL lets backend determine limits automatically. yint Numeric. Y-axis tick interval. Default 10. flip Logical. Invert axes (horizontal bars). Default FALSE.

what: Build a Figure from a Specification — hd_make
title: Build a Figure from a Specification — hd_make
text: Renders hd_spec hd_opts pair using selected backend geometry.  central function package — everything else feeds flows hd_make().

title: Build a Figure from a Specification — hd_make
code: hd_make(   spec,   type = "column",   opts = NULL,   backend = "highcharter",   use_js = TRUE,   module = TRUE,   filename = NULL,   smooth = TRUE,   dot_size = 4,   line_symbols = NULL,   inner_size = "0%",   level = "county",   value_lab = NULL,   na_fill = "#D3D3D3",   low_col = "#C6DBEF",   high_col = "#025169",   ... )

title: Build a Figure from a Specification — hd_make
text: spec hd_spec object hd_spec(). type Character.  Geometry name — one list_geoms(): "column", "line", "scatter", "arearange", "pie", custom geometry added register_geom(). opts hd_opts object NULL (uses defaults). Controls title, subtitle, caption, ylim, yint, flip, per-figure colours, highcharter theme. backend Character.  Rendering engine — "highcharter" (default, interactive) "ggplot2" (static), engine added register_backend(). use_js Logical.  TRUE (default) injects hover-band htmlwidgets::JS() callback via point.events.mouseOver/. Tooltips, accessibility module, Highcharts declarative features always present.  Set FALSE clean, -custom-JS widgets.  Ignored ggplot2 backend. module Use available modules js CDN https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts filename Character NULL.  Base filename Highcharts export menu (extension).  Default: "highdir-figure". smooth Logical.  type = "line" — spline curves (TRUE, default) straight segments (FALSE). dot_size Numeric.  type = "line" / "scatter" — marker radius pixels.  Default 4. line_symbols Character vector NULL.  type = "line" — per-group Highcharts marker symbols.  Valid: "circle", "square", "diamond", "triangle", "triangle-". inner_size Character NULL.  type = "pie" — inner radius CSS percentage string, e.g. "50%" donut chart. Default "0%" (solid pie). level Character.  type = "map" — "county" (default) fylker "municipality" kommuner. value_lab Character NULL.  type = "map" — label shown colour-scale legend.  Defaults spec$ylab. na_fill Character.  type = "map" — fill colour regions data.  Default "#D3D3D3". low_col Character.  type = "map", ggplot2 backend — low end continuous gradient.  Default "#C6DBEF". high_col Character.  type = "map", ggplot2 backend — high end continuous gradient.  Default "#025169". ... Extra arguments forwarded geometry function. Required arguments (e.g. ymin, ymax "arearange") must supplied .

title: Build a Figure from a Specification — hd_make
text: highchart widget (highcharter backend) ggplot object (ggplot2 backend), invisibly wrapped knitr/Shiny render automatically.

title: Build a Figure from a Specification — hd_make
code: spec <- hd_spec(df, x = "age", y = "pct", group = "sex", n = "n") opts <- hd_opts(title = "Health survey", ylim = c(0, 80))  hd_make(spec, "column", opts)                       # highcharter (default) hd_make(spec, "column", opts, backend = "ggplot2")  # static ggplot2 hd_make(spec, "line",   opts, smooth = TRUE)        # smooth spline hd_make(spec, "pie",    opts)                       # pie / donut

title: Build a Figure from a Specification — hd_make
code: df <- data.frame(   age = rep(c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"), each = 2),   sex = rep(c("Male", "Female"), 4),   pct = c(42, 38, 55, 61, 48, 52, 60, 57),   n   = c(120, 115, 200, 210, 180, 175, 160, 155) )  spec <- hd_spec(df, x = "age", y = "pct", group = "sex", n = "n")  opts <- hd_opts(title    = "Health survey results",                  subtitle = "Source: FHI 2024",                  ylim     = c(0, 80))  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # ── Interactive charts (highcharter) ────────────────────────────────────── hd_make(spec, "column", opts) hd_make(spec, "line",   opts, smooth = TRUE) hd_make(spec, "line",   opts, smooth = FALSE, dot_size = 6) hd_make(spec, "scatter")  # Pie chart — group is ignored; x = label, y = value pie_df   <- data.frame(category = c("A","B","C","D"),                         value    = c(35, 25, 20, 20)) pie_spec <- hd_spec(pie_df, x = "category", y = "value") pie_opts <- hd_opts(title = "Share by category") hd_make(pie_spec, "pie", pie_opts) hd_make(pie_spec, "pie", pie_opts, inner_size = "50%")  # donut  # Arearange — requires ymin + ymax in ... df2   <- cbind(df, lo = df$pct - 5, hi = df$pct + 5) spec2 <- hd_spec(df2, "age", "pct", group = "sex") hd_make(spec2, "arearange", opts, ymin = "lo", ymax = "hi")  # ── Disable JS hover band ───────────────────────────────────────────────── hd_make(spec, "column", opts, use_js = FALSE)  # ── Static ggplot2 versions ─────────────────────────────────────────────── hd_make(spec, "column",  opts, backend = "ggplot2") hd_make(spec, "line",    opts, backend = "ggplot2") hd_make(spec, "scatter", opts, backend = "ggplot2") hd_make(pie_spec, "pie", pie_opts, backend = "ggplot2")  # ── Reuse spec with different presentation ──────────────────────────────── opts_no <- hd_opts(title = "Helseundersøkelse", subtitle = "Alle aldre") hd_make(spec, "column", opts_no)  # ── Save outputs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── hd_save(hd_make(spec, "column", opts),               "column.html") hd_save(hd_make(spec, "column", opts, backend="ggplot2"), "column.png") } # }

title: Create Figure Presentation Options — hd_opts
text: title Character NULL. Chart title. subtitle Character NULL. Subtitle.  Highcharter default: "Kilde: Navn av kilder". caption Character NULL. Caption text (highcharter ). xlab Character NULL. X-axis label. " " (default) Use x column name hd_spec(). NULL Hide x-axis label completely. string Use string label. ylab Character NULL. Y-axis label. rules xlab. ylim Numeric vector length 2 NULL. Fixed y-axis limits, e.g. c(0, 100). yint Positive numeric. Y-axis tick interval.  Default 10. flip Logical. Invert axes (horizontal bars).  Default FALSE. colors Character vector, palette name string, NULL. Per-figure colour override; takes precedence hd_set_theme(). hc_theme Character NULL. Per-figure highcharter theme name; takes precedence hd_set_theme().

what: highdir: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Helsedirektoratet — highdir-package
title: highdir: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Helsedirektoratet — highdir-package
text: highdir provides unified API building interactive figures highcharter static figures ggplot2.  figure described data-mapping object (hd_spec) optional presentation object (hd_opts), rendered either backend without changing calling code.

title: highdir: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Helsedirektoratet — highdir-package
code: library(highdir)  # ── 1. Sample data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── df <- data.frame(   age = rep(c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"), each = 2),   sex = rep(c("Male", "Female"), 4),   pct = c(42, 38, 55, 61, 48, 52, 60, 57),   n   = c(120, 115, 200, 210, 180, 175, 160, 155) )  # ── 2. Describe the data mapping (once) ────────────────────────────────── spec <- hd_spec(df, x = "age", y = "pct", group = "sex", n = "n",                  ylab = "Percentage (%)")  # ── 3. Describe the presentation (reusable across specs) ───────────────── opts <- hd_opts(title    = "Health survey results",                  subtitle = "Source: FHI 2024",                  caption  = "Tall om helse",                  ylim     = c(0, 80))  # ── 4. Render — swap backend without touching spec or opts ──────────────── hd_make(spec, "column", opts)                        # interactive HC hd_make(spec, "column", opts, backend = "ggplot2")   # static ggplot2 hd_make(spec, "line",   opts, smooth = TRUE)         # HC spline hd_make(spec, "line",   opts, backend = "ggplot2")   # gg line hd_make(spec, "scatter")                             # HC scatter  # ── 5. Choropleth maps — Norway counties and municipalities ────────────── # County map (fylker) county_df <- no_counties() county_df$value <- round(runif(15, 10, 80)) map_spec <- hd_spec(county_df, x = "fylkesnummer", y = "value") map_opts <- hd_opts(title = "Helse per fylke", subtitle = "Kilde: FHI 2024") hd_make(map_spec, "map", map_opts)                          # interactive HC hd_make(map_spec, "map", map_opts, backend = "ggplot2")     # static ggplot2  # Municipality map (kommuner) muni_df <- no_municipalities() muni_df$value <- round(runif(nrow(muni_df), 5, 100)) m_spec <- hd_spec(muni_df, x = "kommunenummer", y = "value") hd_make(m_spec, "map", map_opts, level = "municipality")  # Donut chart hd_make(pie_spec, "pie", pie_opts, inner_size = "50%")  # ── 6. Arearange (confidence intervals) ────────────────────────────────── df2   <- cbind(df, lo = df$pct - 5, hi = df$pct + 5) spec2 <- hd_spec(df2, "age", "pct", group = "sex") hd_make(spec2, "arearange", opts, ymin = "lo", ymax = "hi")  # ── 7. Save to disk ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── hd_save(hd_make(spec, "column", opts),               "chart.html") hd_save(hd_make(spec, "column", opts, backend="ggplot2"), "chart.png")  # ── 8. Session-wide styling ─────────────────────────────────────────────── hd_set_theme(hc_theme = "economist",              colors   = c("#025169","#7C145C","#C68803"))  # ── 9. Launch the Shiny GUI ─────────────────────────────────────────────── hd_app()

title: Build a Figure from a Specification — make_fig
text: spec fig_spec object created fig_spec(). type Character. Geometry use. One values returned list_geoms(): "column", "line", "scatter", "arearange", custom geometry registered register_geom(). backend Character. Rendering backend. One "highcharter" (default, interactive) "ggplot2" (static), backend registered register_backend(). use_js Logical. Whether include manually-injected JavaScript enhancements highcharter output. Tooltips, hover states, accessibility module, declarative Highcharts features always included regardless setting. TRUE (default), htmlwidgets::JS() hover band added behind active category column/point via point.events.mouseOver / mouseOut. Set FALSE omit custom callback, e.g. want clean widget hand-written JS. effect ggplot2 backend. filename Character NULL. Base filename used Highcharts built-export menu (extension). Defaults "highdir-figure". Ignored ggplot2 backend. smooth Logical. type = "line" . Use spline interpolation smooth curves (TRUE, default) straight line segments (FALSE). dot_size Numeric. type = "line" . Radius line markers pixels. Default 4. line_symbols Character vector NULL. type = "line" . Marker symbol group. Valid values: "circle", "square", "diamond", "triangle", "triangle-". NULL symbols assigned automatically. colors Character vector NULL. Colour overrides figure . NULL palette hd_set_theme() (hdir default palette) used. ... Additional arguments forwarded geometry's render function. Required arguments geometry (e.g. ymin / ymax "arearange") must supplied .

code: df <- data.frame(   age  = rep(c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"), each = 2),   sex  = rep(c("Male", "Female"), 4),   pct  = c(42, 38, 55, 61, 48, 52, 60, 57),   n    = c(120, 115, 200, 210, 180, 175, 160, 155) )  spec <- fig_spec(   data     = df,   x        = "age",   y        = "pct",   group    = "sex",   n        = "n",   title    = "Health survey results",   subtitle = "Source: Example data",   caption  = "Tall om helse" ) #> Error in fig_spec(data = df, x = "age", y = "pct", group = "sex", n = "n",     title = "Health survey results", subtitle = "Source: Example data",     caption = "Tall om helse"): could not find function "fig_spec"  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Interactive highcharter column chart (default) make_fig(spec, "column")  # Same data as a smooth line chart — with JS hover effects make_fig(spec, "line", smooth = TRUE)  # Disable JS (e.g. for self-contained HTML export) make_fig(spec, "column", use_js = FALSE)  # Static ggplot2 version make_fig(spec, "column", backend = "ggplot2")  # Arearange needs extra required args spec2 <- fig_spec(df, x = "age", y = "pct", group = "sex") make_fig(spec2, "arearange", ymin = "pct_lo", ymax = "pct_hi") } # }

title: Create Interactive Highchart Graph with Categories and Groups — make_hist
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(highcharter) library(dplyr)  # Sample data survey_data <- data.frame(   age_group = rep(c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"), each = 3),   gender = rep(c("Male", "Female", "Other"), 4),   percentage = runif(12, 10, 80),   count = sample(50:200, 12) )  # Basic column chart make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Survey Results by Age and Gender")  # Chart with fixed y-axis scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Fixed Y-axis Scale",           ylim = c(0, 70))  # Smooth line chart with custom symbols and fixed scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Smooth Trend Analysis",           type = "line",           smooth = TRUE,           ylim = c(0, 100),           line_symbols = c("circle", "square", "diamond"))  # Regular (angular) line chart make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Angular Line Chart",           type = "line",           smooth = FALSE)  # Horizontal bar chart with fixed scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Horizontal View",           flip = TRUE,           ylim = c(0, 50))  # Custom y-axis intervals with fixed scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Fine-grained Y-axis",           yint = 5,           ylim = c(0, 60)) } # }
